findings.finding: Count α=±x^t·D, deg≤8, where D is product of distinct cyclotomic Φ_{2d} with same v₂(d). List even m≤30 with φ(m)≤8 → Φ₂,Φ₄,Φ₆,Φ₈,Φ₁₀,Φ₁₂,Φ₁₄,Φ₁₆,Φ₁₈,Φ₂₀,Φ₂₄,Φ₃₀. Group by v₂(m/2): v=0:{2,6,10,14,18,30}, v=1:{4,12,20}, v=2:{8,24}, v=3:{16}. Subsets per group with total degree≤8 give 22 distinct D (incl. 1). For each D, t∈[0,8−deg(D)], sign± → 2·(9−deg(D)) α. Sum=160. Pitfall: double‑count D=1 across groups.

Factor α as A(z)=z^s·D(z). Need A·B=z^k+z^l ⇒ D|1+z^d. D must be product of distinct cyclotomics Φ_{2^t·m} with same v₂, deg≤8. List t=1..4, m odd with φ(m)≤8/2^{t-1}: t1 m={1,3,5,7,9,15} (deg 1,2,4,6,6,8); t2 m={1,3,5} (deg2,4,8); t3 m={1,3} (deg4,8); t4 m={1} (deg8). Count subsets per t with total deg≤8: N₁=15,N₂
